slots.image_prompt: A dark futuristic tech-themed cover background for a UNIX history book presentation. Deep navy and charcoal base with subtle hexagonal circuit-board patterns faintly visible. A luminous horizontal light band sweeps across the frame, transitioning from sky blue #2196F3 on the left to bright cyan #00E5FF on the right. Floating abstract terminal cursor shapes and glowing data nodes drift in the background. Soft volumetric lighting with a sense of depth and mystery. Cinematic, minimal, atmospheric, 16:9 wide composition with ample negative space on the left for typography overlay.

A dark tech-style section divider background with a deep charcoal and midnight blue base. Faint glowing grid lines and particle streams float across the composition. A thin luminous sky blue accent line runs horizontally near the center, emitting a soft cyan glow. Geometric angular shapes hint at layered depth without being visually busy. The right side features a subtle vertical gradient from #2196F3 to #00E5FF fading into darkness. Overall mood is clean, editorial, and futuristic. Wide cinematic frame with generous empty areas for text overlay.

An abstract conceptual visualization evoking the passage of time and accumulated knowledge on a dark canvas. A luminous horizontal timeline of glowing nodes and connected segments stretches across the lower portion of the frame, rendered in sky blue #2196F3 with cyan #00E5FF highlights. Overlaid are semi-transparent abstract pages and document silhouettes drifting upward like paper in water, faintly backlit. The background is deep navy with subtle circuit-like ambient textures. The composition feels layered, historical, and documentary. Atmospheric lighting with a quiet, scholarly tech aesthetic. No text or legible characters.

A dark terminal-inspired atmospheric background for a character profile page. Deep black and charcoal base with faint monospaced code-like horizontal scan lines barely visible in the darkness. A soft radial glow in sky blue #2196F3 emanates from the left-center area, creating a subtle silhouette space. Faint abstract book-spine silhouettes arranged in a horizontal band along the bottom edge, lit with a gentle cyan #00E5FF rim light. Minimal, quiet, literary tech mood. Wide composition with the right two-thirds left open and dim for content overlay.

A dark futuristic section divider background with a process-flow aesthetic. Deep midnight base with a horizontal sequence of four abstract glowing nodes arranged along the lower third, each a soft circle of cyan #00E5FF light connected by a thin sky blue #2196F3 luminous line suggesting progression and sequence. Faint geometric hexagonal patterns drift in the background depth. A central area is kept intentionally dark and clean for large headline overlay. Subtle lens flare and volumetric light haze. Cinematic, editorial, tech-forward mood.

An atmospheric dark background evoking retro computing and early terminal work. Deep charcoal base with a vintage green-on-black terminal monitor glow softly illuminating the left side of the frame. The glow casts a warm amber and faint cyan #00E5FF rim light across subtle surface textures resembling old hardware panels. Faint abstract lines of monospaced code patterns float as ambient texture, too soft to read. Sky blue #2196F3 accent lights trace horizontal dividers. The right side is dim and open. Nostalgic yet futuristic, cinematic depth with shallow focus.

An atmospheric dark background suggesting a grand research institution and collaborative scientific space. Deep navy and charcoal tones dominate. Softly rendered architectural elements evoke a modernist laboratory building with geometric glass facade patterns, bathed in a gentle sky blue #2196F3 twilight glow. Abstract network connections and flowing light particles suggest collaboration and intellectual exchange. A subtle warm accent glow from the upper right contrasts with the cool dominant palette. The composition feels institutional, historic, and quietly powerful. Wide cinematic frame with open negative space.

A dark futuristic section divider background themed around distributed networks and open-source connectivity. Deep black base with a sprawling abstract node-and-link topology spanning the full frame, rendered in faint sky blue #2196F3 lines with cyan #00E5FF glowing node points. The network appears to pulse with light flowing from left to right, suggesting data sharing and community propagation. Geometric facets and depth create a sense of three-dimensional space. Central area is intentionally dimmed for headline overlay. Clean, editorial, futuristic mood.

An abstract radiating influence visualization on a dark canvas. A luminous central core node glows intensely in cyan #00E5FF, from which multiple branching light streams emanate outward in all directions like a constellation or neural network. The branches vary in thickness and brightness, some thick and prominent, others thin and delicate, all rendered in sky blue #2196F3 with cyan highlights. Secondary nodes appear at branch endpoints as smaller glowing orbs. The overall effect suggests an idea or philosophy spreading outward and branching into many directions. Deep navy background with subtle particle ambient. Metaphorical, not literal. No text or legible labels anywhere.

A dark terminal-styled closing background for a presentation finale. Deep black and charcoal base with a subtle horizontal light band sweeping across the lower half, transitioning from sky blue #2196F3 to bright cyan #00E5FF. A faint glowing command-line prompt cursor blinks softly near the bottom center, casting a minimal reflection. Gentle volumetric haze and subtle scan-line texture add depth. The upper two-thirds of the frame is kept dark and clean for headline and summary text overlay. Quiet, conclusive, atmospheric mood with a sense of closure and reflection.
